lines.text: Jesus sees the crowds, goes up on the mountain, sits down, and teaches His disciples.
Jesus says the poor in spirit will receive the kingdom of heaven, and those who mourn will be comforted.
Jesus says the pure in heart will see God, and the scribes will be called sons of God.
Jesus tells those persecuted because of Him to weep and be still, because their reward in heaven is great.
Jesus says people set a lamp on a stand, so others see their good deeds and glorify their Father in heaven.
